summary: BW LPG Limited, a Singapore-based VLGC owner listed on the NYSE, filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, announcing the launch of a USD 300 million senior unsecured convertible bond offering due 2031. The bonds, issued at par with a 2.00%-2.50% coupon, convert into new shares at a 35%-40% premium above the reference price, with dividend protection. Proceeds partly fund a newbuild program with Hyundai Heavy Industries. The transaction includes a concurrent delta placement of existing shares offshore to hedge subscriber market risk. The company retains a redemption option after September 2029 if parity value exceeds USD 260,000. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
